capabilities: Run a local Model Context Protocol server inside Obsidian over Streamable HTTP
Expose notes, backlinks, metadata, attachments, and vault stats to connected AI agents
Let agents create, edit, append, patch, rename, and delete notes
Search notes by date, tags, frontmatter, full text, or regex
Enforce access control with bearer token auth and path/tag blacklists
extras: Beta status ("Production Ready Logic"); installed via BRAT; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; includes an instructions section written for AI agents configuring clients.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for external AI agents to read the active note, search the vault, or create and edit notes.

relations.evidence: Claude Desktop does not natively support Streamable HTTP in its config file. Use the mcp-remote proxy
Claude Code natively supports Streamable HTTP. Add the server via CLI
OpenClaw does not yet support MCP natively. Use the bundled OpenClaw skill instead

requires.name: an MCP client such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or OpenClaw

summary: Local MCP server that lets external AI agents such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Claude Code read, search, and edit vault notes.
